note: Hand-kept join table for the commodity-lng bundle (docs/COMMODITIES-PLAN.md §12.6.1 item 2). GEM ids are the GGIT project ids; EIA project names are the 'Project name' column of the quarterly liquefaction workbook; DOE names are the 'Point of Entry or Exit' column of the monthly LNG exports file; eiaApiTerminal is the poe2 series terminal code, filled at milestone 7 when the key path lands (null until then). The build fails on any US export terminal or DOE exit name that does not resolve here.

usExportTerminals.name: American LNG Hialeah
usExportTerminals.why: 0.08 Mtpa ISO-container plant; below the EIA workbook's large-scale threshold and ships no vessel cargoes

eiaProjectsOutsideGemSet.Commonwealth LNG: EIA lists it as FID (Under construction); GEM Sept 2025 still carries every train as proposed, so it has no marker until GEM moves it
eiaProjectsOutsideGemSet.Delfin FLNG: EIA lists it as FID; GEM Sept 2025 carries it as proposed

doeExitsOutsideUs.why: US-sourced pipeline gas liquefied at New Fortress's Altamira FLNG; DOE files it as a US export by point of exit

Puerto Rico.why: GEM files San Juan under United States with Puerto Rico as the subnational; GIIGNL and DOE count it as its own market

Russia Europe.why: GIIGNL splits Russia by basin; Yamal LNG is the Atlantic-basin exporter

Russia Asia.why: Sakhalin II is the Pacific-basin exporter

USA.why: largest operating US export terminal by GEM operating capacity (Sabine Pass)
